def solve():
    grid_size = 18
    X = [(x, y) for x in range(1, grid_size + 1) for y in range(1, grid_size + 1)]
    
    count_needed = 0
    for y_target in X:
        x_t, y_t = y_target
        # Find all pillars p such that max(|x-x_t|, |y-y_t|) >= 2
        possible_p = [p for p in X if max(abs(p[0] - x_t), abs(p[1] - y_t)) >= 2]
        
        # Now we need to find if there are two pillars p1, p2 in possible_p 
        # such that max(|x1-x2|, |y1-y2|) >= 2
        found = False
        for i in range(len(possible_p)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(possible_p)):
                p1 = possible_p[i]
                p2 = possible_p[j]
                if max(abs(p1[0] - p2[0]), abs(p1[1] - p2[1])) >= 2:
                    found = True
                    break
            if found:
                break
        
        if found:
            count_needed += 1
            
    return count_needed

print(solve())
